page_title: JUV 1-1 SAS | Juventus v Sassuolo 21/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.

90+6' A fine solo run by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
90+5' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marchetti had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.
90+4' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Josh Doig (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch so that Domenico Berardi can be given a rest.
90+1' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' Substitution. Francisco Conceicao makes his way off the pitch and Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) comes on as his replacement.

87' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom right corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, though, allowing Arijanet Muric to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
86' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
86' The Juventus players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

86' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. That's a penalty to Juventus! They have a good chance to score now.

84' Play continues despite the shouts by some Juventus players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Matteo Marchetti interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
84' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
82' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
80' It's time for a substitution. M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) comes on in place of Andrea Pinamonti.
79' Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch because Aster Vranckx simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
79' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) replacing Jeremie Boga.
79' Substitution. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) has come on for Lloyd Kelly.
76' Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
74' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
73' Arijanet Muric makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom left corner by Jeremie Boga (Juventus).
72' A pass from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is intercepted by Mattia Perin and the move breaks down.
71' Great teamplay by Juventus as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
69' Here is a change. Cristian Volpato is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
69' Darryl Bakola comes off the pitch to be replaced by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo).
67' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
67' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

66' Ambitious effort from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
65' The foul by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) was seen by Matteo Marchetti who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
64' Bremer (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
64' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
62' Luciano Spalletti prepares a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso is replaced by Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
62' The substitution is prepared. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Khephren Thuram.
61' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
60' Juventus exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.

57' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
56' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It's a throw-in for Sassuolo.
56' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:5.
53' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) attempts to find Khephren Thuram, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

52' 1 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Domenico Berardi picks out an unmarked Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
52' Sassuolo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
50' The ball is cleared after Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
49' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
48' The Juventus players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.

41' Golden chance! Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
39' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
39' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
38' Juventus control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
36' Matteo Marchetti has a clear sight and sees a foul from Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo). That's a free kick to Juventus.
35' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Arijanet Muric has no trouble gathering it.
34' Weston McKennie (Juventus) plays a lovely through ball to Jeremie Boga, but he can't beat Arijanet Muric and loses the ball.
33' Juventus are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
31' Juventus hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
28' The game is pretty dull as Sassuolo are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.

26' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) wastes an opportunity to score with a header from deep inside the box. His effort flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
26' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
25' The cross into the penalty area from Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
25' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Jeremie Boga (Juventus), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
23' Sassuolo are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
20' Juventus fail to score from a corner as Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) leaps to collect the ball.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Juventus.
17' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
16' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is teed up on the edge of the box by Francisco Conceicao, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
13' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
13' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
11' Nice passing game by Sassuolo. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
8' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
8' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and it's Weston McKennie (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
6' Sassuolo are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
3' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
3' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
3' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) is about to take a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Juventus will kick the game off.
Matteo Marchetti will referee today's match.
